## Resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change makes possible. Mention public API changes or compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. State unverified platform/game behavior explicitly.

## Scope notes

For adapters, include the exact game build, channel, storefront, platform, capabilities exercised, and compatibility evidence. For writes, describe validation, execution timing, and failure/recovery behavior. Omit this section when it does not apply.
